program:
app "Business costs" bag plum
table cost what text, amount money, note text?
state m date = today
let spent = sum(cost.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 200000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
"Last month" sum(cost.amount prev month) faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form cost
list cost month of m by day
describe:
Business costs, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- cost: what: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 200000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of cost in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Last month", the total amount of cost last month.
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a cost.
- a list of cost in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Investments" chart ink
table holding name text, units num 0.., cost money, price_now money
let worth = sum(holding, it.units * it.price_now)
let paid = sum(holding.cost)
"Worth" worth big
"Gain" worth - paid bold color if(worth >= paid, good, bad)
each holding sort name as h
  row card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
    stack grow
      h.name bold
      h.units "units" faint
    h.units * h.price_now - h.cost bold color if(h.units * h.price_now >= h.cost, good, bad)
form holding, "Add fund"
describe:
Investments, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- holding: name: text; units: number, at least 0; cost: money; price now: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- worth is the sum of its units times its price now over the holding.
- paid is the total cost of holding.
Shows:
- text: "Worth", worth.
- text: "Gain", worth minus paid.
- for each holding sorted by name:
  - a group; a tap opens the holding for editing; a swipe removes the holding, with undo:
    - text: the name of the holding.
    - text: the units of the holding, "units".
    - text: the units of the holding times the price now of the holding minus the cost of the holding.
- a form to add a holding.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "Stock" package ink
table item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen
let short = count(item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each item sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form item
describe:
Stock, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the item have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "items running low".
- for each item sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the item for editing; a swipe removes the item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the item.
    - text: the kind of the item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the qty of the item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the qty of the item plus 1.
- a form to add a item.

app "Study" school mint
table subject name text
table lesson subject ref subject, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat = Mon, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied subject ref subject, mins num 1..
table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 25m "Focus length"
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

app "Luggage" bag ink
setting limit num = 23 "Bag limit (kg)"
table bag name text
table gear in ref bag, item text, kg num 0.1..30
each bag as b
  stack card gap 1
    row gap 2
      b.name bold grow
      sum(b.gear.kg) "kg" color if(sum(b.gear.kg) > limit, bad, ink)

      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(b.gear.kg) / limit, 0, 1), 4 fill if(sum(b.gear.kg) > limit, bad, good) radius 2
    each b.gear as g

form bag, "Add bag"
form gear, "Add item"

program:
app "Tiffin" food plum
table customer name text
table order customer ref customer, meal pick Lunch|Dinner = Lunch, price money, delivery money = 0
row gap 2
  stat sum(order.price week), "income this week"
  stat sum(order.delivery week), "delivery cost"
  stat sum(order.price week) - sum(order.delivery week), "profit"
"Today's orders" head
each order today as o
  row card
    o.customer.name bold grow
    o.meal
    o.price
"Customers this week" head
each customer as c
  let pr = sum(c.order.price week) - sum(c.order.delivery week)
  row card gap 1 fill if(pr > 0 and pr = max(customer, sum(it.order.price week) - sum(it.order.delivery week)), good, surface)
    c.name bold grow
    count(c.order week) "orders"
    pr bold
    button "+ Lunch" tap add order customer = c, meal = Lunch, price = last(c.order.price)
form customer, "Add customer"
form order, "Add order"
describe:
Tiffin, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- customer: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- order: customer: a customer; meal: one of Lunch, Dinner, starts at Lunch; price: money; delivery: money, starts at 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a big number: the total price of order this week, labelled "income this week".
- a big number: the total delivery of order this week, labelled "delivery cost".
- a big number: the total price of order this week minus the total delivery of order this week, labelled "profit".
- text: "Today's orders".
- for each order today:
  - text: the customer name of the order.
  - text: the meal of the order.
  - text: the price of the order.
- text: "Customers this week".
- for each customer:
  - text: the name of the customer.
  - text: how many the customer's order entries this week, "orders".
  - text: pr.
  - a button "+ Lunch"; a tap adds a order with customer set to the customer, meal set to Lunch, price set to the latest price of the customer's order entries.
- a form to add a customer.
- a form to add a order.
